note: Custer State Park campground in ponderosa pine on the south side of Stockade Lake, along Stockade Lake Drive four miles east of Custer; the lake is a few hundred metres north across the road. Sites suit mid-sized rigs, and there are 13 camping cabins. From Custer on US-16A there are no tunnels. --Claude
